text: publish.py auto-deploys whatever is in the working tree: a run with unrelated WIP committed 79 files (61 back-catalogue featured.json sidecars, four edited 2026-10-08 artifacts, internal_links.*, illustration_log.md, generation_control.json) under the article's own commit message. Check 'git status --porcelain' before the persistence pass and publish with --no-deploy when the tree is dirty; the sweep also removed generation_control.json's _note field, which no gate reads.

The accessibility gate inside the Loop 3 reviewer refuses every all-caps acronym, including one that prose already glosses: 'API' held attempt 2 as an undefined acronym with a note that a gloss reads as invention. Drop the token from prose at drafting time ('public research service', 'the silent-fault work') and leave it only inside cited paper titles; check_accessibility passes such a gloss while humanize_loop3 does not.

The evergreen gate's first run can report figure_absent on a pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov article that verifiably contains the figure: the fetch of the same URL returns a partial page under load. Re-run gate-brief before touching a row — the identical brief PASSed on the second run with every pattern matching.

A publish run can log 'featured image FAILED: art director call failed: frontier output truncated (finish_reason=length)' and still ship the post hero-less. Repair order: re-run illustration_creator --apply (it succeeds on a retry), then attach with 'wp_draft.py --slug <s> --reimage' — '--reconcile-media' SKIPS a post that is already published — then toggle the post draft->publish so the static front rebuilds and serves the hero and og:image.

article_reviewer can return a byte-identical body and report ACCEPT hard=0: compare the _final.md against the _draft.md (diff -q) — an identical file means the frontier never re-voiced. Re-run it with --out to a temp path and adopt that accepted rewrite, then hand-repair the lead and prove it with article_reviewer --audit.

Reviewer rewrites cost 5-13 Flesch points; pre-tune the structural draft to ~57+ with common words (not sentence splitting) so the accepted attempt clears the 50 floor. If run_pipeline.py review HELDs on prose only, re-run via scripts/article_reviewer.py --attempts 2 --keep-attempts — its second attempt fixes its own critic defects. At the push, By-the-numbers lead-ins carry exactly ONE number; move the denominator into the clause.
article_reviewer.py accepts --attempts N while run_pipeline.py review does a single attempt; a prose-only HELD at review is re-runnable, not terminal.
